# Different Cells, Different Solutions

## Evolution Keeps Experimenting

Not every organism solved every problem in exactly the same way.

For example:

- Plant cells usually have a cell wall, chloroplasts and a large vacuole.
- Animal cells do not have a cell wall or chloroplasts.
- Many microorganisms have their own unique adaptations.

Evolution produced many different kinds of cells, all built on the same basic principles.
